title: Design is compromise
summary: Stephen Ango's essay explores how design is fundamentally about making compromises between competing priorities like aesthetics, functionality, cost, and user needs. Rather than chasing a mythical 'perfect' solution, designers must navigate trade-offs and make informed decisions that balance multiple constraints.
problem_solved: Addresses the misconception that good design means finding the ideal solution, reframing compromise as an essential and legitimate part of the design process.
why_valuable: Provides a mature, realistic perspective on design that helps practitioners accept trade-offs as inherent rather than viewing them as failures.
